lines.zh: 我掠过海面，水被压出深沟。
lines.en: I sweep over the sea, pressing a deep trench in it.

lines.zh: 九格高的身体移动时，云都跟着偏。
lines.en: At nine blocks tall, the clouds lean when I move.

lines.zh: 触腕撑地，我推着自己往前滑。
lines.en: My tendrils brace the ground and slide me forward.

lines.zh: 我走过的岸，沙子变成灰白。
lines.en: The shore turns grey-white where I pass.

lines.zh: 我贴着海岸线走，像在丈量领地。
lines.en: I hug the coastline as if measuring my domain.

lines.zh: 气从鳃缝里喷出，带咸味。
lines.en: Air jets from my gill slits, salt-laden.
One stride carries me over a whole reef.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住了半片林子。
lines.en: My shadow covers half the woods.
Bone plates shift beneath my hide.
I am slow, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 我停在海边，身体微微起伏。
lines.en: I halt at the shore, my body swelling and settling.
The tide strikes me; I do not move.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只触腕，又放下。
lines.en: I lift one tendril and let it fall.
Something swims beneath my skin.

lines.zh: 我张开鳃，吸了一口咸空气。
lines.en: I flare my gills and draw the salt air.
A small boat is far off; I have seen it.
I file it away.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸像退潮，一阵一阵。
lines.en: My breathing comes in waves, like the tide.
Seaweed hangs from my back spines.
I turn my head slowly.
Drops roll from the seams of my plates.

lines.zh: 我在等海把岸线交给我。
lines.en: I wait for the sea to hand me the shoreline.
I understand the sound of the waves.

lines.zh: 我垂下头，听海底的低鸣。
lines.en: I lower my head and listen to the seabed's hum.

lines.zh: 浪退下去，我的甲上留下一层白盐。
lines.en: The wave recedes, leaving white salt on my plates.

lines.zh: 我把一根触腕探进沙里，试了试深度。
lines.en: I probe the sand with a tendril, testing its depth.

lines.zh: 我转过头，整个身体都跟着。
lines.en: I turn my head, and my whole body with it.
You are standing on my tideline.
I look down at you without blinking for a long while.

lines.zh: 你的气味像陆地上的东西。
lines.en: Your scent is of the land.

lines.zh: 我伸出一根触腕，停在你面前。
lines.en: I extend one tendril and stop it before you.
It is thicker than your arm.
I withdraw it.
You did not run.
I smell the sea on you.
I sound a low note.
It comes from deep in my chest.
You step back and the ground sways.

lines.zh: 我的甲裂了一道，渗出蓝水。
lines.en: A plate cracks and blue fluid seeps.
I call, the sound muffled in water.
My tendrils recoil.
I give half a step back and crush the bank.
The wound closes slowly.
It is not pain, only an obstacle.
I swallow the severed tendril.
I plant myself again.
The sea will make up for it.
I raise my head as my bone plates close again.

lines.zh: 陆地上的东西填不满我。
lines.en: Nothing from the land can ever fill me.
I pull my tendril back.
The reek of the sea is far stronger.
I glance at it.
Then I look away.
Land food cannot fill me.
I sound a low note of refusal.

lines.zh: 你捏着那点东西，指节发白。
lines.en: You pinch that little thing till your knuckles whiten.
I push it back.
The tide is here.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，像撞上礁石。
lines.en: You hit my leg like a reef.
I do not notice.

lines.zh: 触腕擦过你，把你带倒了。
lines.en: A tendril brushes you and takes you down.
I stop and wait for you to rise.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片蹭过你的护甲。
lines.en: My scales scrape your armor.
I crowd you against a wall of rock.
I shift away slowly.
Our feet leave wet pits.

lines.zh: 水从我身上滴到你脸上。
lines.en: Water drips from me onto your face.
I keep walking toward the sea.
The fountain of ecology needs no mate.
I am the source; I propagate alone.
Offspring slough off from my body.
I look down at them.
They will take this place for me.
This is evolution, not love.
I flare my gills and let the water pass.
The sea answers.

lines.zh: 我的身体又长大了一点。
lines.en: My body grows a little again.
The tide has written it down.
I curl a tendril around it.
It is laughably small in my grip.
I raise it to my eyes.
I have no eyelids.

lines.zh: 我用触腕把它摆回原样。
lines.en: I set it back as it was with one tentacle.
This one I keep.
I swallow it.
The taste is faint.
I spit out a piece of bone.
The tide will carry off the rest.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，海水从甲缝里倒下来。
lines.en: I raise my head and seawater pours off my plates.

lines.zh: 六十四格之内，都是我的范围。
lines.en: Sixty-four blocks: all of it within my reach.

lines.zh: 你的心跳在岸上太响了。
lines.en: Your heartbeat is far too loud on this shore.
There is nowhere for you to hide.
I turn slowly.
The motion makes the shore sway.
All my tendrils lift.

lines.zh: 它们比你见过的任何东西都多。
lines.en: There are more of them than you have seen.
I call, and the sea calls with me.
You retreat into the water: worse for you.
I drag the whole tideline in with me.
The tide helps you, and it helps me more.
I can see you even underwater.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气冲进我的鳃。
lines.en: The heat of your body pours into my gills.
I open my mouth.
There are several rows of teeth.
I sound one last note.
It is a verdict.

lines.zh: 我每一步都震得你站不稳。
lines.en: Each of my steps shakes you off balance.

lines.zh: 我的触腕从侧面绕过去。
lines.en: My tendrils curl in from the side.

lines.zh: 你砍断一根，又长出两根。
lines.en: You cut one; two more grow.

lines.zh: 海在涨，我的速度也快起来。
lines.en: The tide rises and so does my speed.
I rise out of the water.

lines.zh: 你退到岩壁上，没有路了。
lines.en: You back to a cliff; there is no road.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，甲片对上你。
lines.en: I lower my body, plates toward you.

lines.zh: 我的骨刺划过石头，火星都出来了。
lines.en: My spines rake the stone and spark.

lines.zh: 你砍在我甲上，只留一道白印。
lines.en: Your blade leaves one white mark.
That scratch isn't worth my notice.
I lift a whole bank of tendrils.

lines.zh: 它们落下来的时候，天都黑了。
lines.en: When they fall, the light goes out.
You roll out through a gap.
I turn and follow.
Water offers me no resistance.
Your breath is ragged.
I hear it.
The last step.

lines.zh: 你的脚步在沙上太响了。
lines.en: Your steps are too loud on sand.

lines.zh: 我抬起一整排触腕，挡住你身后的路。
lines.en: I raise a rank of tendrils and close the way behind you.

lines.zh: 触腕横扫，把你整个人卷起来。
lines.en: A tendril sweeps you up whole.

lines.zh: 我甩出去，你撞在礁石上。
lines.en: I fling; you hit the reef.
A row of spines comes down.

lines.zh: 我用整个身体的重量撞。
lines.en: I ram with the weight of my whole body.

lines.zh: 我的口张开，里面都是牙。
lines.en: My mouth opens, full of teeth.

lines.zh: 海水跟着我一起打过去。
lines.en: Seawater strikes with me.
You are pressed into the sand.
Tendrils wrap your legs.
I am pulling upward.

lines.zh: 你砍断了一根，我换了一根。
lines.en: You cut one; I offer another.
My bone plates slam your chest.
You are thrown far.

lines.zh: 我整条腿砸下，岸裂开了。
lines.en: My whole leg slams down and the shore splits.

lines.zh: 潮水把冲开的沙又填回来。
lines.en: The tide fills the sand back in.

lines.zh: 海面先是鼓起来，然后我出现。
lines.en: The sea swells first; then I appear.

lines.zh: 我从深水里站起，水只到我腰间。
lines.en: I rise from deep water; it reaches only my waist.
The shoreline retreats in a ring.

lines.zh: 我张开鳃，第一口气很冷。
lines.en: I flare my gills; the first breath is cold.
My body is still growing.
Plates lock into place one by one.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，水从指间流下。
lines.en: I raise a hand; water streams from it.
The seawater darkens at my feet.
A village lies far off; I have seen it.
This land will serve.
I take my first step.
The beach dents.
My low call carries far.
The sea answers me.
Offspring hatch at my feet.
They will go first.
I will follow.
The tide has risen.

lines.zh: 我低鸣一声，整片海面都起了波纹。
lines.en: I sound a note and the whole sea ripples.
Every bird on the shore takes flight.
Fire on my plates gives off a fishy smoke.

lines.zh: 我从高处砸下来，岸都被压塌。
lines.en: I crash from above and the shore buckles.
In water I am only clearer.
The blast tips me sideways.
It lodges in a seam of my plates.
Magic burrows through my body.

lines.zh: 我饿得开始吃自己的子代。
lines.en: Hunger turns me on my own offspring.
Lightning falls; the water dissipates it.

lines.zh: 虚空把我往深处拉，我挣着。
lines.en: The void drags me down; I struggle.
